scenario_stem:

Annual revenue reached $340,000 last year, but sales have fallen 8% over the past 6 months after a supermarket launched its own-label coffee at $7 a bag, against Millbrook's $12.

The managing director must choose a marketing strategy for the next 12 months. Option one is a promotional pricing campaign, cutting the bag price to $9 for 6 months at an estimated cost of $15,000 in lost margin. Option two is investing $18,000 in a premium brand image campaign: new packaging, storytelling and a loyalty card for repeat buyers. The board meets on 30 March to decide.

scenario_stem:
Whiteoak Creamery is a small ice-cream maker in Country X producing 8 flavours from its farm near Tarnley. It sells through 15 local shops, employs 6 staff and took in $85,000 last year, trading for 9 years. A national supermarket chain has offered to stock Whiteoak across Marisport, home to 220,000 people, if it can supply 30,000 tubs a year at $2.20 per tub versus the $4 direct price.

The owners must set a marketing strategy for the coming year. Option one is signing the supermarket supply deal for 2 years, worth about $66,000 a year. Option two is focusing on the home market: a new flavour, tastings at 6 summer fairs and a loyalty card costing $4,000. A decision is due by 31 May before orders are placed.

Opportunity 2: Listing in national supermarkets would raise national brand awareness [k], helping Whiteoak reach far beyond its 15 local shops without paying for advertising [app].

scenario_stem:
Quernmore Furniture Co is a workshop in Country X making solid-wood tables and chairs. It employs 14 staff, trading for 13 years, and earned $480,000 last year from sales through 3 showroom partners. The workshop prides itself on local oak, and it is launching an 'eco-oak' range made from certified timber that costs 15% more to produce.

The partners must pick a marketing strategy for the launch. Local timber suppliers deliver to the workshop fortnightly. Option one is an eco-focused brand campaign: a dedicated web page, showroom displays and sponsoring a green-homes exhibition, costing $7,500. Option two is a 20% launch discount on the eco-oak range for 8 weeks, estimated at $9,600 in reduced margin. The partners expect a recommendation at the July meeting.
